name: What questions should I ask before starting a structural remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important questions to ask before hiring for structural remodeling?
mainEntity.text: What are the most important questions to ask before hiring for structural remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a structural remodel, homeowners should ask a contractor who is responsible for each stage of the work. Key topics include engineering, permit submittal, plan check revisions, temporary support, utility relocation, inspection scheduling, and finish restoration. It is also important to understand what happens if the crew finds rot, termite damage, unpermitted work, or framing that differs from the original plans. A clear answer on contingency budgets and change-order pricing can prevent conflict later. Ask for examples of similar projects, proof of insurance, and a realistic project timeline that includes approvals, not just construction. The best conversations happen before demolition, not after. These questions help the owner compare bids accurately and choose a team that can handle both the design and the field realities of older Los Angeles-area homes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask who is handling design, engineering, permits, inspections, shoring, utility relocation, contingency pricing, and final finish repairs. Also ask how hidden damage, change orders, and schedule delays will be handled if the opening reveals unexpected conditions.
